==Skin Trivia==
*The original Level 5 scaffolding went down to ground normally occupied by ground towers.
*The {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} skin was not updated alongside the Default skin [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] with the exception of its skin color.
**Because of this, the {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} skin was broken until the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]].
*On specific levels, the shells the '''Mortar''' drops into the cannon differ from the ones fired out.
**The levels at which these differ depends on the skin. For most skins, it is for Level 3-4.
*In the [[Frost Invasion Event]] trailer, a {{Color|Frost|Frost}} '''Mortar''' is shown. However, the skin was cancelled.
**This skin was later added three years after the release of the [[Frost Invasion Event]].
*On the render seen in the [[Gift Box]] after purchasing the ''Unwavering Tides Bundle'' [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] and the icon of the gamepass itself, and the [[V1.8.4|Unwavering Tides Update]] thumbnail and trailer the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Mortar''' has a different appearance Level 4 than the one in-game.
**Most notably, on the render, the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Mortar''' wears a black and blue coat, while in-game the {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Mortar''' only wears a white shirt.
**The {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Mortar''' has a cutlass and a scabbard for it in the render, both of these are not present in-game.
**The {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Mortar''' has black fingerless gloves in the render, while in-game it wears regular brown gloves.
**On the render, behind the belt, there appears to be red cloth, which is not present in-game.
**The {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} '''Mortar''' in the render appears to have tan skin, while in-game it has a pale skin.
*The {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} and {{Color|Krampus|Defender}} '''Mortar''' skins at Level 5 do a laugh after firing, which is [[mariowiki:Wario|Wario]]'s laugh, from ''Super Smash Brothers: Ultimate''.
*{{Color|Vigilante|Vigilante}}, {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}}, {{Color|Krampus|Defender}}, {{Color|Frost|Frost}}, and {{Color|OperationICE|Dark Frost}} skins at Level 5 has the same firing sound as Level 3-4.
*The {{Color|Christmas2025|Festive}} skin is a submission made by [https://x.com/raincoatedd enbycoated].
**Originally, the skin was designed to be more human, before being altered to give it a more deer-like appearance.
*The {{Color|Beach}} skin was made by mitzu while its concept art was made by TrustlyDragon.<ref>https://x.com/raincoatedd/status/2095908976617726333</ref>

===Roblox Catalog===
*The visor used by the Default, {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} and {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} '''Mortar''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|1163672|2007 ROBLOX Visor}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 3-5 goggles used by the Default, {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}} and {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} '''Mortar''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|4391089678|Combat Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
